title: MoleculeQA: A Dataset to Evaluate Factual Accuracy in Molecular Comprehension

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on MoleculeQA, a multiple-choice question-answering benchmark derived from authoritative molecular corpora (like ChEBI-20 and PubChem), to measure factual accuracy and hallucinations across four molecular aspects: Structure, Property, Application, and Source.
